content.text: Search Microsoft Learn documentation for the OpenAI service.

Here are the most relevant Microsoft Learn resources for the Azure OpenAI Service:

Overview and updates
- Azure OpenAI Service docs hub: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/
- What’s new: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/whats-new

Quickstarts
- Quickstart: Chat completions (REST and SDKs): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/quickstart?tabs=python

Key concepts
- Models and regional availability: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/concepts/models
- On your data (grounding with your own content): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/concepts/use-your-data
- Safety system and content filtering: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/concepts/safety-system
- Quotas and limits: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/quotas-limits

How-to guides
- Function calling (tools): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/function-calling
- Vision (image understanding with GPT-4o): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/gpt-with-vision
- Embeddings: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/embeddings
- Fine-tuning: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/fine-tuning
- Batch requests: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/batch
- Assistants (overview): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/assistants-overview

Security, identity, and networking
- Managed identity: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/managed-identity
- Role-based access control (RBAC): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/role-based-access-control
- Private endpoints (Private Link): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/private-link

Reference
- Azure OpenAI REST API reference (hub): https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/reference
- Full REST reference set: https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azureopenai/
- Python SDK: https://learn.microsoft.com/python/api/overview/azure/ai-openai-readme
- .NET SDK: https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/overview/azure/ai.openai-readme
- JavaScript/TypeScript SDK: https://learn.microsoft.com/javascript/api/overview/azure/ai-openai-readme
- Java SDK: https://learn.microsoft.com/java/api/overview/azure/ai-openai-readme

Operations and troubleshooting
- Samples gallery: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/samples
- Troubleshooting guide: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/troubleshoot

Training (Microsoft Learn modules)
- Fundamentals of Azure OpenAI Service: https://learn.microsoft.com/training/modules/fundamentals-azure-openai/
- Prompt engineering with Azure OpenAI: https://learn.microsoft.com/training/modules/prompt-engineering-azure-openai/

If you have a specific scenario (for example: chat with tools, RAG/on-your-data, fine-tuning, or networking/security), tell me and I can pull the exact pages and examples you need.
